events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit on origin/main and recent deploys
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git merge-base --is-ancestor 42a1a35 origin/main && echo ON_MAIN; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git rev-list --count 42a1a35..origin/main; git log --oneline 42a1a35..origin/main -- cloud/ | head -20; ls cloud/migrations | tail -3; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; grep -n "revops-centre" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether latest deploy already contains the commit
events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor 42a1a35 97096ab && echo 42_IN_97096ab; git log -1 --format='%h %ci %s' 42a1a35; git log -1 --format='%h %ci' 97096ab; grep -nE "DEPLOYED|Worker [0-9a-f]{8}" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -4 | cut -c1-260; cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Created|Version|Message" | tail -6

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find live version origin and probe usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -n "7bbeec3c\|305ddc97" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300; git grep -c "charge.refunded" origin/main -- cloud/funnel/worker.js cloud/src/connectors/build.ts; sed -n 1,25p cloud/scripts/probe-stripe-refunds.mjs | grep -iE "sim|usage|run|port" | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run tsc and refund probe in clean worktree at origin/main
events.input: $ WT=~/.t238-verify-wt && git worktree add -q --detach $WT origin/main && cd $WT/cloud && (npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -3; echo TSC_EXIT=$?; node scripts/probe-stripe-refunds.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Link app deps and rerun probe
events.input: $ sed -n 10,15p ~/.t238-verify-wt/cloud/scripts/probe-stripe-refunds.mjs; ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules ~/.t238-verify-wt/app/node_modules && cd ~/.t238-verify-wt/cloud && node scripts/probe-stripe-refunds.mjs 2>&1 | tail -14

events.text: Probe is all green on origin/main. Now I'm checking the live Worker, cleaning up, and logging.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Remove worktree and check live centre
events.input: $ rm ~/.t238-verify-wt/app/node_modules; git worktree remove --force ~/.t238-verify-wt && echo WT_REMOVED; for u in https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/ https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $u\n" "$u?v=t238"; done; git rev-parse --short origin/main
